summary: Gores Holdings XI, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its IPO and a simultaneous private placement. The IPO of 35,880,000 units at $10.00/unit generated gross proceeds of $358.8 million; each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-fourth of a warrant exercisable at $11.50. The sponsor purchased 225,000 private placement shares at $10.00/share. A total of $358.8 million was placed in trust. This is a standard SPAC formation event; no business combination is announced. Watch for the de-SPAC timeline and potential target announcement within the typical 24-month window.
